Operational question: Are conclusions stable across independent seeds, splits or project panels?
Evidence used here: Primary and extension seeds; classifier split variability; real-panel network stability
What a favorable result establishes: Consistency of an analytical result under the observed design and heterogeneity
What it does not establish: Correctness against truth, ecological validity or transportability

Operational question: How well does a method recover the truth implemented by a specified simulator?
Evidence used here: DA FDP, power and F1; core F1 and false-core rate; network AUPRC; classifier accuracy and rejection
What a favorable result establishes: Performance under the stated truth definition and generator
What it does not establish: Accuracy on real data or generalization to unseen projects

Operational question: Does a generator fitted to some projects reproduce the aggregate structure of withheld projects?
Evidence used here: Fixed-tolerance passes and empirical interval coverage across 30 held-out panels
What it does not establish: Method accuracy, FDP or ranking on real held-out outcomes
